description: Source file implementing the TransformFeedback class and related functions for managing transform feedback operations in OpenGL, including buffer management, state handling, and primitive drawing calculations.

classes.name: TransformFeedback
classes.description: Class managing OpenGL transform feedback operations, including starting, ending, pausing, resuming, buffer binding, and state management.

classes.name: TransformFeedbackState
classes.description: Struct holding the state information for a TransformFeedback instance, including buffers, primitive mode, vertices drawn, and program reference.

methods.name: GetVerticesNeededForDraw
methods.description: Calculates the number of vertices needed for a draw call based on primitive mode, count, and primcount.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::begin
methods.description: Starts transform feedback with specified primitive mode and program, calculating buffer capacity.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::end
methods.description: Ends transform feedback, releasing resources and resetting state.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::onVerticesDrawn
methods.description: Updates the count of vertices drawn after a draw call.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::bindProgram
methods.description: Binds a program to the transform feedback object.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the transform feedback object.

methods.name: TransformFeedback::bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a specific index for transform feedback.
